name: My MariaDB Codespace
postCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y mariadb-server php php-mysql && sudo service mariadb start && sudo mariadb -e "ALTER USER 'root'@'localhost' IDENTIFIED BY 'password'; FLUSH PRIVILEGES;" && sudo mariadb -u root -ppassword < /workspaces/2026-Website/database_dump/schema.sql
